articles.title: Biomass cooking fuels raise toxic metal exposure risks in Bangladesh, study finds
articles.summary: Burning biomass fuels like dry wood and rice husk for cooking can produce air pollution and contribute to toxic heavy metals buildup inside rural kitchens in Bangladesh, a new study finds. Md. Badiuzz
articles.ecoTip: Reduce vehicle use on high-pollution days. Check AQI before going outdoors. Use public transport or carpool.

articles.title: In Nepal and Tibet, Pollution on Glaciers Could Fuel More Flood Disasters
articles.summary: Darkened by soot from vehicles and factories, the region’s glaciers are absorbing more heat and melting at dangerous rates.
